intent: When a player is knocked out by a bomb chain, everyone sees a floating "+1" and the name of whoever started the chain above the victim for 1.5 seconds, so the scorer of each knockout is clear.
accept: Every knockout caused by another player shows "+1" and the chain starter's name above the victim's position
The tag stays about 1.5 seconds then disappears, and is visible to other players and spectators, not only the scorer
A self-inflicted knockout shows no +1 or scorer name
In a chain with several victims each victim gets its own tag naming the same starter
